title: Text Widget
subtitle: Display styled text with single or multiple lines in Flutter.

properties.name: style
properties.description: Defines typography styling including color, font size, weight, letter spacing, decoration, shadows, and word spacing.

properties.name: textAlign
properties.description: Aligns the text horizontally within its parent constraints. Values include left, right, center, and justify.

properties.name: overflow
properties.description: Configures how to render text that overflows the parent boundaries (e.g. clip, ellipsis, fade).

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: Limits the maximum number of text lines. Often used with overflow.ellipsis to show truncated text cleanly.
